home.title: WELCOME TO ANALOGIUM
home.subtitle: <0>ANALOGIUM is a society committed to document twisted universes, insane minds and creatures incomprehensible to the average human, as well as the souls who gave their time and sanity to develop them.</0><1>Imagine a world where the United States harbours strange creatures among its monuments; imagine a county terrorised by <2>'Doppelgängers'</2> of its inhabitants; imagine a human trapped in a machine forgotten at the bottom of the ocean. All these and more stories neatly documented in one place.</1>

origin.title: THE ORIGIN OF ANALOGIUM
origin.part1: <0><1>PART I: One-Man Show</1></0><2>Our society was born from an entity in constant pain, a human being like you or me, with a life so miserable that it is 'forgettable'; he fled for a long time in his own mind, thinking and dreaming of new worlds and alternate histories to those of our world. Eventually he made the decision to archive and share these worlds that gave him so much fear and comfort over the years. That's how <3>ANALOGIUM</3> was born... yet is not the end of our story.</2><4>Although the project filled our founding father with life, the work was too much and soon, along with private events, took its toll on his mental state. He knew he needed help, but all the time he spent locked in his own dome ended his ability to go out and talk to other humans. He became a hermit, and finding someone as fallen and broken as he was was practically impossible... until <5>she</5> arrived to his life.</4>
origin.part2: <0><1>PART II: From Bliss to Feeling Half-Death</1></0><2>'<3>Lady</3>' was everything to our creator, she was the only person in a long time to understand and heal the creator's mental wounds. He himself described her as '<4>a fallen angel</4>'...  But unfortunately nothing good can last for anyone, and one day 'Lady' evaporated from our father's life. This left him completely devastated, he didn't smile, he didn't see, he didn't move, he was just present, lifeless.</2><5>Nobody knows for sure what broke our founder's fairytale, not even the ones closest to him; the only thing he allows himself to say is: <6><7><8>It Was My Fault</8></7></6></5>
origin.part3: <0><1>PART III: Among Ashes</1></0><2>It took a long time for our founder to heal, full of empty replacements, insane acts and feelings amplified by his own pain; until in a monument of clarity, the stories that had locked him in his mind for so long resounded in his mind, and he found something that made him happy again, however temporary it seemed. He worked as hardly as he could but at last, he felt whole. Now our founding father was not alone, he managed to find a team that had the same mind as him. <3><4>He Found a Family</4></3></2>

fnaf.title: FNAF VHS
fnaf.intro: <0>FNAF VHS is a series created by Squimpus McGrimpus via YouTube. The series is made up of 2 seasons and is based on the <1>Five Nights At Freddy's</1> games (only covering the first 4 games), created by Scott Cawthon </0>
fnaf.synop: <0>Old footage from Fazbear Entertainment is starting to arrise from the shadows, and is not your avarage work guides. These held the memories and story of the 8 components of a giant curse: The Murderer, 5 Victims... and the hope of the fallen. </0>
fnaf.part1: <0><1><2>Welcome to Fazbear Entertainment's Maintenance Video Manual<3>Our protagonist finds four tapes of the company Fazbear Entertainment, these tapes being material for the workers of his chain of pizzerias Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, and his famous animatronic mascots: Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy.<4>The first tape shows a manual on how to clean the animatronics, using Freddy as an example. Step by step, it shows how to dismantle the animatronics for cleaning, until we get to the final part, where the torso is removed to reveal... blood.
fnaf.part2: <0><1><2><3>Freddy's insides</3></2></1></0><4>The second tape tests the movements Bonnie can perform, in order to prevent any failure of her metallic joints. However, halfway through the tests Bonnie begins to act peculiarly, first remaining static, then seeking refuge in the shadows, until finally she attacks the camera and cuts the video.</4><5>After a brief static, a mysterious gift appears in front of the camera, from the first victim and the one who plans to end it all once and for all: <6>The Puppet</6>.</5><7>The third tape prepares Chica to test her sound detection and see if everything works as it should... At this point it should come as no surprise that something weird ends up happening with Chica, but now it's something more “human”... <8>She speaks directly to the camera.</8></7>
fnaf.part3: <0>THIS MUSIC MAKES ME FEEL BETTER.</0><1>IT MAKES ME THINK ABOUT BIRDS.<2>I LIKE BIRDS.<3>THEY ARE PRETTY.</1><4>ONE TIME, I SAW A BIRD SLEEPING IN THE SNOW.<5>THAT'S WHAT BAD DREAMS ARE ABOUT.</4><6>I FEEL LIKE I'M SLEEPING IN SNOW.<7>AND I CAN'T GET UP.<8>IT'S TOO COLD FOR ME TO DO THAT.</6><9>THINGS DON'T BREATHE WHEN THEY SLEEP IN SNOW.<10>I CAN'T BREATHE.</9><11>I CAN'T BREATHE.</11>
fnaf.part4: <0>The last tape shows a short prologue of Foxy the Pirate's show, where he invites the kids to show up in 3 minutes or there will be serious consequences, like sending Freddy and the rest of the crew to David Jones' Locker, or asking for a raise (I think that joke was more aimed at the parents)... until he presents the silhouette of 5 kids, of which one disappears. The video now repeats without music, and near the end the audio cuts out completely, being replaced with an alarm.</0><1>Another of the children disappears, and the video repeats a third time, now with a synthetic voice demanding that we stop watching the tape. The video cuts in half and the last remaining children disappear, and from the shadows...<2>“he” appears</2>.</1><3>WHAT'S THE MATTER, FOXY?<4>I THOUGHT YOU WANTED AN AUDIENCE</3><5>It would seem that this is the end, but one last gift is given to our protagonist... <6>a fifth tape</6> that shows in depth everything that has happened in this chain of pizzerias, and how everything is going to end.</5><7>A familiar entity starts talking to whoever is watching the tape, explaining that, since always, the place was a dangerous place thanks to the Spring-Lock suits, going through the accident that killed our brother and that now, because of our father, everything is even worse. Father? Brother? Who is this entity talking to? To our protagonist, <8>Michael Afton</8>.</7><9>His brother, Joseph (Golden Freddy), would die in an accident at Fredbear's Family Dinner because of Michael, where his head would be crushed by Fredbear's jaws; his father, William Afton (the Purple Guy), would go mad because of this and murder 5 children on the establishments, with Puppet's soul being the first victim. She would since help the others by possessing the costumes of the other animatronics, and plotting revenge against William, who despite dying inside a Spring-Lock suit, his soul is still trapped with the others. Now with Micheal's help, a happy ending looks possible.</9><10>And how? We still need to wait for <11>the Horror Attraction</11>.</10>
fnaf.part5: <0>This ends the first act, where Puppet presents Michael with the strategy to end the curse of the pizzerias. But we are far from the end: 7 new tapes enter the formula.</0><1><2><3>Welcome to your new job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!</3></2></1><4>The sixth tape is a training video for the night security guards, introducing the employees to the tools they will use, such as the camera system, the door controls, the danger posed by the animatronics, and a strange golden rabbit who wants to <5>talk to his boy</5>. At certain points in the film, certain distortions show William in the shadows, trying to get closer to Michael, even giving him indications of where he is trapped.</4><6>The seventh film returns with the testing of the animatronics, now with the Toy models and their new facial recognition technology. Whoever is recording the test shows various photos to the robot, some containing innocent people and others containing people with criminal records; should the latter appear the animatronic will emit a subtle alarm. It sounds simple, and it is simple... until one last photo over-alarms the animatronic, who attacks the employee (who fortunately saved himself). But why, instead of alarming, did it attack? Toy Bonnie didn't recognise a criminal, it recognised <7><8>THE CRIMINAL</8></7>.</6>
fnaf.part6: <0><1><2><3>CRIMINAL</3></2></1></0><4>The eighth tape, rather than work footage, is a security camera recording, capturing Chica and Bonnie leaving the stage. As the two meet between the tables, they start talking to each other about who might be in the office now, at which point Chica mentions that if it was “him” who is hiding, he should be sorry for what he did to her <5>good brother</5>; Bonnie starts to cry and is grateful that his sister doesn't know exactly what is going on. The two separate and the song <6>Lullaby of The Leaves</6> begins to play on stage.<7>This particular film is the rawest of the whole collection, because it reminds us that, inside those killer pets, behind all the curse of the establishment... <8>there are only children waiting to go home.</8></4><9>The ninth tape is a communiqué to the employees of Fredbear's Family Dinner, notifying them of the changes to be made to the pizzeria after the accident that killed Joseph, including the removal of Spring-Lock technology, and the replacement of Springbonnie and Fredbear with the foursome we all know best. Fazbear Entertainment's management had as a priority the public reaction and the constant questions that would come after these changes, however they already had a solution for that: <10>deny <11>everything</11></10>.</9>
fnaf.part7: <0>i don't exist?</0><1>you said you were sorry<2>and that you loved me</1><3>but i know you're lying<4>you don't love me<5>that's what you always said</3><6>i don't love you either<7>and i'll take you with me</6><8>so you'll know how it feels<9>to stop existing</8>
fnaf.part8: <0>The tenth tape shows a cartoon based on the mascots of the pizzeria, and what they do after closing the place. This particular episode shows the gang getting ready for pizza for dinner, until they notice something strange in the dining room: there are 6 chairs and only 4 people. Freddy doesn't pay much attention to that and says it must be a “strange coincidence”; Chica, not entirely convinced, starts looking through boxes for something that shows the opposite of what Freddy said, until she finds a photograph of the band with two silhouettes of a rabbit and a bear. Strange sounds lead her to the kitchen, where she finds Golden Freddy who wants to talk to all of them: Joseph still doesn't trust his brother, he still hates him for everything that happened in '83; he can't save them, they would never go to heaven.</0>
fnaf.part9: <0><1><2>we're never getting out</2></1></0><3>The penultimate tape is a recording of William Afton himself, where he confesses to the murder of “The 5 Missing Childrens of Freddy's”, and delves into his motives and modus operandi. William was left with the anger of having lost his little Joseph to a son he always hated, and to free himself from all that torment he decided to drown himself with other children who were just like Michael in his eyes: complete brats.<4>After confessing, William gives a final warning to whoever is listening to the tape: he checks the place where he hid the tape every day to see if it has moved, even if it is millimetres apart. So you'd better put the tape down Michael, <5>and start running</5>.</3><6>The final tape is a series of voice recordings of William after he died inside the Springbonnie suit, and how he was waiting for Michael from 1993 to 2008, from Freddy Fazbear's Pizza to Fazbear's Fright: <7>The Horror Attraction</7>. It's now or never, Michael is on the premises along with Puppet, the souls of the children, and his own father, ready to end this curse once and for all.</6><8>To Nicole Morales, Lucas and Angie Collins, and Benjamin Nelson: I hope your souls find the freedom that has been denied to you for so many years.<9>To Charlie Emily: I hope you rest in the knowledge of all you did for those grateful children, they would still be there if it wasn't for your help.<10>To Michael and Joseph Afton: I hope you both find the “sorry” you have been missing, that you will find peace in God's kingdom.<11>To William Afton: <12>I hope you <13>die in a fire</13>.</12></8>
fnaf.note: <0>MESSAGE FROM OUR FATHER:<1>The ANALOGIUM Society does not condone Grooming or any similar sin. In no other universe have we seen anything as horrendous as this kind of inhumane behaviour. If you have committed or are committing these acts, we wish you luck in trying to enter Hell.<2>PEOPLE LIKE YOU DESERVE A WORSE PUNISHMENT.</0>

mythos.title: THE MONUMENT MYTHOS
mythos.intro: <0>The Monument Mythos is a tale developed by MISTER MANTICORE (Alex Casanas) via YouTube. The series have 3 seasons and a Spin-Off known as <1>THE NIXONVERSE</1>.</0>
mythos.synop: <0>SYNOPSIS</0><1>The series chronicles the strange happenings that America doesn't usually talk about, or do you think an entire government would chatter about a monster inside the Statue of Liberty like it's nothing?<2>Some similar things happen all over the country (and somewhere in Egypt), like an entire island that actively sprawls, a parallel dimension, an “angel” inside the Air-Force One and a crystal as sharp as it is mysterious.</1>

nixon.title: THE NIXONVERSE
nixon.intro: <0>THE NIXONVERSE is a tale developed by MISTER MANTICORE (Alex Casanas) via YouTube in 2022. The series is a Spin-Off of his main story, <1>THE MONUMENT MYTHOS</1>, and an expansion for one of Alex oldest videos, <2>THE HOUSE IN THE OCEAN</2>.<3>In 2023 it got an expansion called “<4>THE ABSOLUTE NIXONVERSE</4>”.</0>
nixon.synop: <0>The series take place after the events of the second season of MONUMENT MYTHOS, in a different universe with a fairly familiar form; the story connects three <1>containers for God's <2>GOODNESS</2>, <3>WILL</3> and <4>AUTHORITY</4></1>, who slowly become mad thanks to one simple thing: <5>our world is not kind, <6>our world will never be kind</6></5>.</0>
nixon.act0: <0>PROLOGUE - THE END OF ANOTHER WORLD</0><1>Before anything can happen, we need to adress one key element of our world, <2>The Nature of Alcatraz Matter</2>: if we put together a regular atom and an Alcatraz atom, the particles of the regular one will mutate to the properties and characteristics of the Alcatraz one, acting similarly to a parasite than anything else. This allegory makes more sense knowing that every Alcatraz atom has <3>its own mind, brain and neurons</3>. Now with knowladge captured, we can <4>wake the Horned Serpent</4>.</1>
nixon.act1-1: <0>ACT I - THE CHILDREN OF GOD</0><1>Our story begins with a docummental created by Alice Avenue, talking about a hero who turned the fate of the Amercian soldiers that arrived to Normandy and accepted death as their destiny. They baptized him as <2>The D-Day Knight</2>, and prayed that at any time, at any place, he could save us. During D-Day, the Knight lost his helmet and when researchers found it in the battlefield, it had a lot of damage. Luckly for us, they managed to restore it to its full glory... however something looked odd, why a knight would have a whole craneum as his helmet? What kind of <3>horned creature</3> would ever have squeletic formation like that to begin with?</1>
nixon.act1-2: <0>However, he's not the only hero of this land. There's another being borned taller than a man, and stil decides to keep himself at the size of one, but even he could conquer and hurt us all if he desires to: <1>The Last Son of Alcatraz.</1> He's just naive and has a great desire to protect humans, he's a better hero than the Knight would ever aspire to be.</0><2>Finally the third container is showed to us, but not in our usual planet, this time is somewhere more special... like <3>the Moon.</3><4>The Apollo 11 odyssey captured in photos and recordings a woman living on the Moon, a queen waiting for her people to come back to her authority: <5>The Queen of the Lunarian.</5> Before Ed Dwight could step out of the lander and become the first man on the Moon, the Queen started a seech that she had prepared for a long time, the first ever recorded words on the Moon. Unfortunely a tiny blood stain covered the entire moment, as after commanding Ed to blast the Queen, John Glenn was <6>evicted from reality</6>.</2>
nixon.act2-1: <0>ACT II - THE HOUSE OF GOD</0><1>A queen for nobody living on the Moon, and the <2>Knight and Day</2> balance in between the Knight and the Son, it was just a matter of time for everything to go wrong... <3>way too wrong.</3> Going forward, in the middle of the Korean War, the Last Son ended up interviening in the name of America, even stopping the Knight for going <4>“<5>too far</5>”.</4> Once his job was done, he returned to his fortress on Alaska, fully oblivious about the tiny present that followed him home. <6>American nuclear missiles</6>.</1><7>Why would the United States kidnap one of their heros? They have a big plan, but before it could take place they need something else: thanks to the research that Apollo 11 did on Lunarian anatomy, Apollo 12 was sended to the Moon with the objective to shoot the Queen and recover her eye. Once back on Earth, the big transformation of the Last Son took place, he was brainwashed and became a bastardized impersonator of our original savior, the one who will bring to our land a distorted vision of world peace: <8>Jesus Christ.</8></7>
nixon.act2-2: <0>With our “Lord” created, tha US sended the Son to theoreticlly redeem the rest of the world, starting on Vietnam (now called Bethlenam). They started spreading their vision and their power everywhere, like a virus, but at some point the Son regained his senses, he opened his eyes (well... his one eye) and he saw all the pain he created under the Lord mantra. He flew away into his hideout, now called Dark Alaska, and he hid inside an imitation of his childhood home: the Son built a house... <1>in the ocean.</1></0><2>The House in the Ocean is not an urban legend.<3><4>IT IS A COVER STORY</4></2>
nixon.act3-1: <0>ACT III - THE THRONE OF GOD</0><1>While all this havoc was happening on Earth, what was going on with the Queen? She was hiding inside an empty city underground, remembering all the events that brought her at this point, recalling her <2>story</2>.</1><3>She never knew how she got to the Moon, let alone how she was alive, but what she knew is that she was the Queen of... someone. She searched the entirety of the Moon and yet, no subjects were found. She hoped deep within herself that one day her kingdom would return, and by that time she wanted to get everything ready, she wanted her people to find confort and equality in her arms. She built a city below the surface, with houses, parks, air and her own throne, still no one in sight; until finally, after a long time a ship touched the surface of her Moon... but she was met with pain. The ship was from the US, and the astronauts aboard wanted nothing but <4>her eye.</4> Once they left and still wounded, the Queen crawled back to her lonely empire, and when she reached her throne something changed, her throne was vandalized and left with a message for the Queen:</3>
nixon.act3-2: <0>The time of her lifetime has finally come, soon the <1>container of God's <2>ISOLATION</2></1> would leave her empty world to rule a new, better one, whether they accepted her... <3>or not.</3><4>Out of the clouds of her sky, she crafted a ship and leaved the Moon forever. Her new kingdom was calling, but first a quick stop in Dark Alaska, right where the House in the Ocean resides. The Queen quickly notices that the powers and abilities of the Son were more similar to the King her prophecy told, so she invited him to join her kingdom and rule with her... it only took one little <5>drastic</5> action for the Son to reclaim his throne. He finally got to one final form, he's no longer either a man, a hero or the Lord, he was at last... <6>The Crescent King.</6></0>
nixon.act4-1: <0>ACT IV - THE KNIGHT OF GOD</0><1>Queen and King started “<2>lunarianizing</2>” humans, resembeling the look of their king, with crescent heads and unstable anatomy. For those who still were humans, something worse was prepared for them, the Lunarians deleted their free choice to join the kingdom or rebel against it, they brainwashed them and deleted their culture, their language, their spirit. Even in the middle of the storm hope can rise... Alice Avenue was back and ready to pray for those who couldn't. Her plan was simple, broadcast the story of the Last Son, hoping for him to wake up and reverse himself.</1><3>The Last Son was a young man like you and me, with parents who were cutthroats and classmates who were worse. The boy was always alone when he went to school, and always in those moments driving towards his destiny, he doubted his role in the universe; he always thought that he had to help everyone around him, and that he had to win at any cost. One day in the midst of his thoughts, the young man was involved in a car crash; still strong enough to move, he got out of his car and approached the dying man with whom he had collided, a familiar face from another universe... <4>James Dean</4>.</3><5>“You won, little bastard... you won...”, this were the last words of the man who in this universe, lost. The Last Son was devastated and could not hold back his tears, and from the pain and exhaustion caused by the accident, he fainted. He woke up in a strange dream afterwards, where he found himself on a cliff with a vehicle driving at high speed towards him. He, to avoid the impact, jumped into the void, and began to believe more and more that he could fly, that he could beat death... he did it. The young man began to fly high, faster than an airplane. It was right here that he woke up and flew as far away as possible from the scene of the accident. He kept on believing, and kept on winning at any cost in order to save everyone. Always up in the sky, <6>it's a bird, it's a plane, it's The Last Son of Alcatraz</6></5><7>Alice not only prayed that the Crescent King would remember the hero he was before becoming a <8>container of God's <9>PAIN</9></8>, she also hoped that the Knight would return to save us all again. He listened to her words and executed a desperate plan to make the humanity of the Last Son wake up again: throw Alice off the top of the Chrysler Building hoping that he would rescue her... <10>that never happened</10>.</7>
nixon.act4-2: <0>After the Knight's plan failed in every way, the Lunarians continued their plans. It's at this point that the Knight would compose a message apologizing for what happened to Alice, and that she was still alive... “<1>IN MY WURLD, STATUUES HELLD SOLES</1>”. Yet, something inside the Knight left him unsatisfied, something made him feel hollow and just angry at himself, at being a terrible American and dissapointing his whole country. To try to redeem himself he removed the head of the Alice Avenue memorial statue and wear it as one of his old helmets; even though he had only worn it for a day something in him changed, the only thing that could be seen was his eye, full of anger... he become a <2>container of God's <3>RAGE</3></2>.</0>
nixon.act5-1: <0>ACT V - GOD</0><1>Let's go back in time for a bit, when Ed Dwight landed on the Moon. His body was found right there, and his autopsy determined that his death was caused by his own ray-gun; next to him was a tape which would be referred to as “THE MOON GOD”. This tape holds a conversation between Ed and someone special, the one behind the existance of the Son, the Knight and the Queen: The God of this universe... <2>Richard Nixon.</2></1>
nixon.act5-2: <0>In the present time, the prophecy is still missing one final being for the Lunarian kingdom to be whole: the Knight. Telepathically, the Queen tries to convince him to leave the land that broke him and join the kingdom as Prince. However, the Knight, amidst all the anger he has, still remember the words of Alice, that “at any time, at any place, the Knight could SAVE US”, and unleashes a final movement that would restore the damages made by the Lunarians, he exploded his soul into pure Alcatraz matter, wich started to attack the Lunarian bodies, destroy the cloud ships and restore human culture: <1>ALCATRAZ CHECKMATE</1>.</0><2>However, there is still the King, who has finally become aware of all he has done, and breaks down in tears once again. Grief made him a monster and he just wants to dissapear from his own misery, but in an instant, he mutates again, becoming a way <3>too dangerous</3> creature, exactly what Nixon feared he would become... <4><5>THE HORNED SERPENT LIVES</5></4>.</2>
nixon.act5-3: <0>Nixon must act fast, he can't let it all end like his own world ended, so he decided to render everything as fiction, the same way our monsters became nothing but urban legends. That's how this whole world was fictionalized, and became a comic known as “The Nixonverse”, with an endearing story made by a certain “Mister Manticore” and beautifully illustrated by... <1>Ed Dwight?</1></0><2>Compared to Nixon, Ed Dwight was twice the God he was, Nixon was just one of many survivors who erased the past, to run from the present. Ed was everything Nixon wasn't, someone bold, kind and good. He never went to the Moon, let alone talked to a God, he is today in our world creating monuments... <3>Ed Dwight preserves the past.</3></2>
nixon.block3: <0>Beauty is something else, something inexplicable that each person carries inside. This form of beauty related to Her vision.<1><2>There's a <3>great division</3> coming about on this planet. There are going to be a lot of people who will die because they just don't know how to live. They don't know what life's about, they don't know how to give, how to love - nor do they want to<4><5>And those who are beautiful enough - I don't mean physically but something beyond that - they will have the chance to learn how to fly, to be beautiful, to rise above the level of the normal human - to be superior beings first and eventually <6>gods and goddesses.</6></0>
nixon.block4: <0>OUR FREEDOM ᐳ YOUR FREEDOM<1>OUR CHRIST ᐳ YOUR CHRIST<2>= WORLD PEACE</0>
nixon.block5: <0>THE LONESOME QUEEN OF MOON ABOVE<1>SHALL BE STRONG FAIR AND KIND<2>SHE'LL RULE THE EARTH BOTH FEARED AND LOVED<3>WITH KNIGHT AND KING BESIDE<4></0>
nixon.block7: Alice Avenue last moments of life.
nixon.block8: Note: The following audio does not feature the voice of Ed Dwight.
nixon.block9: <0>I REMEMBER WHEN I LEFT THE HORNED SEPRENT.<1>I LANDED ON YOUR MOON FIRST.<2>I KNEW BETTER THAN TO SET FOOT ON YOUR WORLD.<3>I WONDERED WHETER YOU ALL WOULD ACCEPT ME OR NOT.<4>TO FIND THE ANSWER, I HAVE RUN AN EXPERIMENT.<5>I PRODUCED THREE BEINGS OUT OF MYSELF.<6>THE SON, THE KNIGHT, AND THE QUEEN.<7>ALL THREE OF THEM ARE EXTENSIONS OF ME.<8>THEY ARE MEANT TO TEST YOUR WORLD.<9>BUT THEY WILL GO MAD, EACH IN THEIR OWN WAY.<10>YOUR WORLD IS NOT KIND TO THEM.<11>YOUR WORLD WILL NEVER BE KIND.<12>THEIR SACRIFICE WILL MAKE ME REALIZE THAT I CAN NEVER RISK STEPPING FOOT ON EARTH EITHER.<13>THE CLOSEST I WILL EVER BE TO YOUR WORLD IS RIGHT HERE, ON THE MOON.<14>ONE MORE THING.<15>IT IS INEVITABLE THAT THE SON WILL BECOME THE KING OF THE LUNARIANS.<16>ONCE HIS TRANSFORMATION IS COMPLETE, I MUST DESTROY HIM, FOR HE WILL BE ONE OF THE MOST DANGEROUS LEADERS IN THE UNIVERSE.<17>THE KING MUST PERISH.<18>I AM SORRY, MR. DWIGHT.<19>NO HUMAN WAS EVER MEANT TO HEAR WHAT I HAVE SAID.</0>
